title: Methodological Blind Spots in Machine Learning Fairness: Lessons from the Philosophy of Science and Computer Science
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. It is a philosophical paper discussing methodological issues in ML fairness.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its focus is on the philosophical and methodological blind spots (abstraction, induction, measurement) in the field of machine learning fairness.
